An American citizen’s baby can’t become a Chinese citizen by being born on the soil of China. Can anyone explain why a Chinese citizen’s baby should be able to become an American citizen by being born on the soil here? It’s absolute insanity.

Again, much of the anger will be on the Supreme Court when they issue their opinion, but this is really about Congressional failure to enact basic, common sense laws for the benefit of American citizens.

Solution two: for any child born in America, the mother must be legally present for six months in the country before the child’s birth. These are basic, common sense solutions that would eliminate much of the birthright citizenship issues. Congress could and should pass them both

Solution one: Most countries in the world do not allow birthright citizenship by soil. Congress should immediately pass a law restricting birthright citizenship by soil to only those countries that also allow Americans born there to be citizens of their countries too.
